rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable but somewhat overcalls features from a soft single image; notes possible collapse appropriately, yet ICM/TE and zona thinning are not sharply discernible and the 3AA vs 4AA discussion is speculative.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian response, prior cycle, male-factor context, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Logical and well-structured overall, with probability estimates and recommendations generally supported; minor issue is some uncertainty in morphology while still leaning strongly on AA quality.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF practice, including SET and cautious use of add-ons/PGT-A; slight overinterpretation of image-based grading details prevents a perfect score.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including luteal support review, routine activity guidance, uterine reassessment, and male-factor follow-up if repeated failure occurs.
